about.title: One unified, open layer to access models across providers and ship reliably.
about.intro: Phaseo is built around practical openness: broad model and provider access, explicit release, deprecation, and retirement tracking, and clear observability so teams can run production workloads with low surprise.
about.howItWorksTitle: A clear path from exploration to production operations.
about.howItWorksDescription: Research models, execute through one API layer, stay current on lifecycle changes, and monitor behavior over time.
about.whatWeBuildTitle: Durable product surfaces that stay useful as AI changes.
about.whatWeBuildDescription: Our goal is simple: keep access broad, interfaces stable, and operations understandable.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.intro: Phaseo's mission is to make access to AI models broad, affordable, transparent, portable, and open.
mission.broadAccessBody: Support as many useful models, providers, modalities, and capabilities as we responsibly can through one consistent interface.
mission.lowestPriceBody: Keep improving routing, infrastructure, and software efficiency, then use those gains to reduce prices and improve the service.
mission.openByDefaultBody: Keep Phaseo open source so the gateway can be inspected, extended, challenged, and improved by the people who depend on it.
mission.usersFirstBody: Make decisions around long-term user benefit, product quality, and fair access rather than pressure for short-term financial returns.
mission.transparencyBody: Make pricing, routing, availability, lifecycle changes, and operational behaviour understandable while keeping data and integrations portable.
mission.technicalExcellenceBody: Compete through accurate data, reliable routing, strong compatibility, useful observability, and a developer experience that feels simple.
mission.builtWithEveryoneBody: Give users, contributors, model creators, and providers meaningful ways to shape the platform and the standards around it.
mission.principlesTitle: The commitments that guide how we build.
mission.principlesDescription: These principles are intended to guide product, pricing, partnership, and business decisions as Phaseo grows.

faq.title: AI model database and gateway FAQ
faq.intro: Practical answers for comparing models, understanding the data, and using the gateway. Cannot find an answer? <support>Reach out to our team</support>.

items.question: How can I compare AI models on Phaseo?
items.answer: Start in the <models>model directory</models>, then open a model page to compare its pricing, providers, benchmark results, latency signals, and compatibility details. The information shown varies with the data available for that model.

items.question: What does a model page tell me?
items.answer: A model page brings together the useful facts for a specific model: who created it, which providers offer it, the listed prices, benchmark coverage, and gateway availability. Use the page tabs to go deeper into pricing, providers, performance, and quickstart details.

items.question: How does Phaseo calculate model pricing?
items.answer: Phaseo stores each provider route's meter, unit size, currency, plan, and effective dates. Input and output rates remain separate, and token prices are normalised per 1M tokens for comparison; they are not combined into a blended headline price. Read the <pricingMethodology>pricing methodology</pricingMethodology> or enter your own token volumes in the <calculator>pricing calculator</calculator>.

items.question: What does gateway availability mean?
items.answer: Gateway availability describes whether Phaseo currently has an eligible route for a model. It is separate from a model's quality or benchmark performance. Provider status can change, so check the model's providers and availability information before relying on a route in production.

items.question: Can I use Phaseo as an AI gateway?
items.answer: Yes. Phaseo Gateway provides one OpenAI-compatible interface for supported models and providers. Create an API key, choose a model, and use the same integration surface while retaining model and provider choice.

items.question: Can I use my own provider API keys?
items.answer: Yes. Bring your own provider keys when you want to retain the provider relationship and billing directly, while still using Phaseo's routing, health, and policy layer.

items.question: Which providers and model types can I explore?
items.answer: Browse the <providers>provider directory</providers> for provider coverage, or filter the model directory by capabilities such as chat, embeddings, image, audio, video, and moderation. A provider page is the best place to check its currently listed model catalogue.

items.question: How are benchmarks and performance data handled?
items.answer: Benchmark scores are shown alongside the benchmark and its methodology so that comparisons retain their context. Read <benchmarkMethodology>how Phaseo normalises AI benchmarks</benchmarkMethodology> and <performanceMethodology>how it measures latency and throughput</performanceMethodology> before making a production decision from a single score.

items.question: What should I do if a listing looks wrong or incomplete?
items.answer: Use the <contribute>contribution page</contribute> to report a correction or add missing information. Accurate, source-backed reports help keep the directory useful as providers change their catalogues and pricing.
